comment: --select-tests reach without --confirm-kills full, with and without --shared-process. As a run of all tests, except for the two mutants of threshold() whose effect the state of another suite hides: the suite that reaches them is run by itself (one process per mutant; with --shared-process because the row of crashes before them has paused shared processes) and fails. They are Killed, marked as detected by narrowed tests alone: the documented limit that --confirm-kills full closes. The suite that needs another suite is named (dependentTests) and its mutants survive.

detailsComment: details: the detail of every mutant of the key must contain one of the texts (which limit stopped the run: without a limit inside the run a Crash is 'the test host ended unexpectedly' after every restart, and a Timeout names the limit of the whole run). maxSeconds: the mutant's time; a crash that is waited through, or a hang waited for with the limit of the whole run, takes longer.
